#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Cron does not guarantee the repository as its working directory.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/job/logs" "$work/bin"
cp backup.sh "$work/job/backup.sh"
cp logs/* "$work/job/logs/"
cat > "$work/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$#" > "$SCP_ARGS"
printf '<%s>\n' "$1" >> "$SCP_ARGS"
printf '<%s>\n' "$2" >> "$SCP_ARGS"
EOF
chmod +x "$work/bin/scp"
SCP_ARGS="$work/scp-args" PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" sh "$work/job/backup.sh" > "$work/output"
test -f "$work/job/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$work/job/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | sort > "$work/tar-contents"
printf '%s\n' '--- output ---'
cat "$work/output"
printf '%s\n' '--- scp arguments ---'
cat "$work/scp-args"
printf '%s\n' '--- archive contents ---'
cat "$work/tar-contents"
test "$(sed -n '1p' "$work/scp-args")" = 2
test "$(sed -n '3p' "$work/scp-args")" = '<backup-srv:/srv/nightly/'
test "$(sed -n '2p' "$work/tar-contents")" = 'logs/app.log'
test "$(sed -n '3p' "$work/tar-contents")" = 'logs/error.log'
